title: Modern Family Policies and Public Debate
grammar: Anteriority clauses with mire ('by the time that') and aspectual completion
goal: I can debate the mechanisms and societal impacts of modern Hungarian family tax credits, CSOK subsidies, and loans.
I can construct complex temporal sentences using mire with perfective verb aspects.
I can discuss tax allowances, home-buying subsidies, and demographic incentives using nuanced B2 terms.
